question: Do both rule-17 guards (scripts/check-root-on-main.ps1 and scripts/check-no-worktrees-in-root.ps1) agree the mechanism is green - together, not just individually - on legitimate state: a worktree next to the repository (not inside it) and the root working copy on 'main'?
why a separate file: Issue #253's criteria require this checked as its own mutant, separate from the RED substitutions in evidence/253-mutant-head-not-main.json and evidence/253-mutant-worktree-in-root.json (each of which also has its own single-guard GREEN restoration). This file is the combined proof: both guards run together, both against a fixture and against the real coordination root.

fixtureCheck.description: Same fixture shape as the two mutant files: a git repo on 'main' with an absolute-path sibling worktree next to it, nothing nested inside it.
setup: git -C <fixture>/root config user.email test@example.com / user.name Test / commit.gpgsign false
echo one > <fixture>/root/a.txt && git -C <fixture>/root add a.txt && git -C <fixture>/root commit -q -m one

realRootReadOnlyCheck.description: Both guards run read-only (no branch switch, no commit - only 'git rev-parse'/'git worktree list', which AGENTS.md rule 17 does not forbid) against the actual coordination root 'C:/gamedev/Dungeon fortress', proving today's real state is exactly the legitimate shape: HEAD on 'main', 15 registered worktrees, all of them outside the root.

wiredRunCheck.description: Both guards also run for real, unconditionally, as the first two actions of scripts/verify.ps1's 'scripts' stage, against whichever checkout the run itself is invoked from. scripts/verify.ps1 -Stage scripts was run from this worktree (a linked worktree, not the root) and both guards reported 'applicable: false' / 'ok' there, which is the correct behaviour for a task worktree - the invariant only binds the root's own checkout. See the PR body for the full -Stage scripts run.
wiredRunCheck.expectedBehaviourInATaskWorktree: applicable=false for check-root-on-main.ps1 (git-dir != git-common-dir); totalRegisteredWorktrees counted with zero offenders for check-no-worktrees-in-root.ps1 (a task worktree's own root has nothing nested inside it either).

cleanup: Fixture removed with 'git worktree prune' plus 'rm -rf .artifacts/evidence-253-fixture'; .artifacts/ is gitignored and nothing here touched the real repository's git state.
conclusion: On legitimate state - fixture and real root alike - both guards agree: exit 0, status ok, no offenders, HEAD on main. Combined with the RED results in evidence/253-mutant-head-not-main.json and evidence/253-mutant-worktree-in-root.json, the mechanism is proven both ways on every state Issue #253 named.
